gaia-3864972938605115520.x: Red dwarf system 7.86 light-years from Sol where Starfleet fought the Borg Cube in 2367 (The Best of Both Worlds).

canon-avatar:polyphemus.x: Blue-and-violet gas giant orbiting in the habitable zone of Alpha Centauri A, orbited by fourteen moons including Pandora.

moon.x: Excavation site of the Tycho Magnetic Anomaly 1 (TMA-1) monolith on the Moon, beaming a radio signal toward Saturn and Jupiter upon exposure to sunlight.
Five-sphere pressurized lunar bubble city near Apollo 11, sustained by tourism and solar/nuclear oxygen smelting.
High lunar orbit sector hosting the International Fleet Battle School where gifted children compete in zero-gravity battle rooms.
Permanent lunar research and water-mining installations established by NASA and the Soviet space program at the lunar south pole.
moon.a: Ronald D. Moore / Matt Wolpert / Ben Nedivi

moon.x: Subterranean lunar penal colony and revolutionary settlement beneath Mare Crisium, governed with the aid of the sentient supercomputer Mike (HOLMES IV).
moon.w: The Moon Is a Harsh Mistress

moon.x: Lunar observatories witnessing the 2034 sudden cosmic quarantine that enclosed the entire Solar System in an impenetrable black sphere.
Lunar headquarters and vast underground installations of the Akinya family industrial empire in Blue Remembered Earth.
Lunar metropolis housing the cryonic cold-pack moratoriums where deceased relatives and psychic operatives are maintained in communicative half-life.

Underground caverns of the insectoid Selenites and the Grand Lunar in H. G. Wells’ First Men in the Moon, and the circumlunar trajectory of the Gun Club’s hollow artillery projectile in Jules Verne’s From the Earth to the Moon.
moon.w: The First Men in the Moon
moon.a: Ray Bradbury, H. G. Wells, Jules Verne

moon.x: The Moon, fractured into seven major fragments by an unknown Agent, where survivors carve the Cleft habitat into an iron core chunk to weather the five-thousand-year Hard Rain.
Automated lunar farside extraction outpost in Moon mining Helium-3 to power Earth, operated by Lunar Industries clones, and the piracy-ridden frontier gateway Copernicus Base in Ad Astra.
Sprawling lunar metropolis in Planetes, staging ground for the first manned expedition to Jupiter, and the industrial manufacturing heartland of Anaheim Electronics in Mobile Suit Gundam.
Early Sovereign Colonies research site on the Moon studying the alien Black Marker signal, leading to the secretive creation of the Red Markers.
Site of six crewed Apollo lunar landings (1969–1972) and numerous robotic sample-return missions.

charon.x: Encased in thick planetary ice, Pluto’s moon Charon is revealed in 2149 to be a dormant mass relay, unlocking instantaneous interstellar transit.
Cryogenic proving ground on Charon where recruit William Mandella and the UNEF force endure brutal survival drills in 30 Kelvin conditions.

gliese-667-c.x: Temperate colony planet orbiting the red dwarf Gliese 667 C, destination of the generation ship flotillas where humans encounter the enigmatic Mandala artifacts.

162173-ryugu.x: Primitive C-type asteroid sampled by JAXA’s Hayabusa2 spacecraft in 2018–2019, returning sub-surface organics and amino acids.

beta-pictoris-b.x: Young, massive super-Jupiter embedded in a massive debris disk, completing an entire rotation in just 8.1 hours (equatorial speed ~100,000 km/h).
